title: Juicy French Bramley Apples Canele
description: A resinous and gooey French dessert featuring Bramley apples in a laminated puff pastry canele, perfect for a date night, served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced Bramley apples, granulated sugar, and salt, and mix until the apples are evenly coated.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Brush the melted unsalted butter evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Arrange the apple mixture in a spiral pattern over the butter, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the apples to form a canele shape, and press the edges to seal.
Place the canele in a lacquerware bowl and brush the tops with the beaten eggs.
Bake the canele in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the canele from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before dusting with confectioners sugar.
Serve the canele warm, garnished with additional sliced apples if desired.
